title: [bundle] Fix the next agent-navigation fail-open gap found after PR #
objective: Fix the next agent-navigation fail-open gap found after PR #221: read-only/lifecycle commands still accept unsupported flags as success. Live audit shows `hf version --definitely-unsupported-flag`, `hf status --definitely-unsupported-flag`, `hf resume --definitely-unsupported-flag`, `hf drift --definitely-unsupported-flag`, `hf release --definitely-unsupported-flag`, and `hf checkpoint --definitely-unsupported-flag` exit 0 instead of rejecting unsupported arguments; release/checkpoint even treat an unsupported flag as a task id/no-op success. Make these commands reject unsupported flags/arguments before doing work, preserve documented help paths and supported flags (`version/status/resume/drift/lease/doctor --json`, `resume --compact`, `checkpoint --auto --quiet --sync-cards`, `release <ID>`), and add CLI regressions proving unsupported flags exit nonzero without creating files in an empty temp repo.
acceptance_criteria: hf version, hf status, hf resume, hf drift, hf release, and hf checkpoint reject unsupported flags/arguments before doing work or treating a flag as a task id.
Unsupported-argument regressions prove those commands exit nonzero and create no files in an empty temp repo.
Documented help paths and supported flags still work: version/status/drift/lease/doctor --json, resume --json/--compact, checkpoint --auto/--quiet/--sync-cards, and release <ID>.
Normal supported lifecycle behavior is not otherwise downgraded.
